items.description: S3 Arctic system with EO/IR gimbal

notes: Joint Forces Command evaluation for Canadian Rangers Arctic operations. Engineering Sprint ROM/SOW submitted 2026-07-31. Demos planned: Ottawa June 24–26, 2026 (flight test + vendor meet); Whitehorse Arctic Nov–Apr 2027. Customer seeks 120km range (1h 35min TOF) S3 with EO/IR gimbal. End of Q2 2027 target at earliest; no delivery dates promised yet. Sales plan organization in progress as of 2026-10-21.
